(7) PostComments renders '@Alexqa' as data-testid='mention-token' in text-sky-600 rgb(2,132,199), and '@Al' in the same comment stays plain text (exactly 1 token in the thread). Reusable notes: (a) OpenAPI is NOT exposed via the public URL — use http://localhost:8001/openapi.json for route-registration checks only. (b) POST /api/reports is idempotent per (reporter,target,status=open), so multi-report ordering tests must insert directly via mongosh with explicit created_at. (c) top_targets is limited to 5 by count, so to assert on your own target insert (current max count + 2) reports. (d) The reports empty state can be tested by renaming the reports collection away and back (see test_empty_state_shape_when_no_reports) or by page.route interception on **/api/admin/reports*. (e) PostComments testids are `toggle-comments-<postId>` / `comment-input-<postId>` (there is no `comments-toggle` prefix). (f) Full suite was NOT rerun this iteration; iter25 reported 417/423 with 6 pre-existing WS-concurrency / push-VAPID / webhook-secret env failures.
